content.text: Access tokens are signed with auth.secret (line 619), but the strategy verifies them with refreshSecret.

candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. AuthService signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (auth.service.ts ~line 619) and signs refresh tokens with refreshSecret. Signature verification therefore fails for every fresh access token, and passport returns 401 on all protected routes. Login and refresh still work because they don't use this strategy.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret: configService.getOrThrow('auth.secret', { infer: true }) as secretOrKey.
